cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Lead Autosar Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.
Perform software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Actively participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Contribute to the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Support software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Work closely with system architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units.
Collaborate with calibration teams to fine-tune control algorithms and enhance software performance.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
8+ Years of hands-on experience in classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow.
Hands-on experience in configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM).
Hands-on experience in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge).
Expertise in manual C coding and debugging.
Good knowledge of Cryptographic algorithms like AES, RSA, etc.
Hands-on experience in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet).
Hands-on experience in configuring NVM manager.
Proficient in programming languages such as C and C++ for embedded systems.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment and communicate clearly.
Excellent problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Preferred Requirements:
Tools - EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, Lauterbach.
Knowledge of microcontroller architecture (Infineon Aurix knowledge is an added advantage).
Experience with MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and tailoring of the MCAL to meet project needs.
Familiarity with software development tools and debugging techniques.
Understanding of automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE).

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, implement, and optimize software that complies with AUTOSAR standards and enhances vehicle performance and functionality. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of AUTOSAR architecture and embedded software development.
cond_0103.responsibilities:
Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.
Perform software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Actively participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Contribute to the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Support software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Work closely with system architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units.
Collaborate with calibration teams to fine-tune control algorithms and enhance software performance.
cond_0103.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
8+ Years of hands-on experience in classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow.
Hands on experience in configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM)
Hands on experience in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge)
Expertise in manual C coding and debugging
Good knowledge of Cryptographic algorithms like AES, RSA, etc.
Hands on experience in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet)
Hands on experience in configuring NVM manager.
Tools - EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, Lauterbach
Knowledge of Micro controller architecture (Infineon Aurix knowledge is added advantage)
Experience of MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and the tailoring of the MCAL to meet the project needs
Proficient in programming languages such as C and C++ for embedded systems.
Familiarity with software development tools and debugging techniques.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment and communicate clearly.
Excellent problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Understanding of automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE) is a plus.

cond_0103.workplace_support: We know there is no one-size-fits-all approach to work. That is why we support flexibility while also creating opportunities for people to connect, build community, and feel a sense of belonging at work.

cond_0114.intro: We are looking for an AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader Lead to join our team. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to design, implement, and optimize software that complies with AUTOSAR standards for automotive applications.
cond_0114.responsibilities:
Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.
Perform software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Actively participate in code reviews, speaking up on code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Contribute to the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Support software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Work closely with system architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams on a regular basis to define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units.
Stay in regular contact with calibration teams to fine-tune control algorithms and enhance software performance.
cond_0114.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
8+ Years of hands-on experience in classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow.
Hands-on experience in configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM).
Hands-on experience in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge).
Expertise in manual C coding and debugging.
Hands-on experience in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet).
Hands-on experience in configuring NVM manager.
Proficient in C and C++ for embedded systems.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment and communicate clearly with colleagues and stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.

Good knowledge of cryptographic algorithms like AES, RSA, etc.
Tools: EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, Lauterbach.
Knowledge of microcontroller architecture (Infineon Aurix is an added advantage).
Experience with MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and tailoring of the MCAL to meet project needs.
Familiarity with software development tools and debugging techniques.
Understanding of automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE).

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of AUTOSAR architecture and embedded bootloader systems.
cond_0166.responsibilities:
Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.
Perform software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Actively participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Contribute to the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Support software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Work closely with system architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units.
Collaborate with calibration teams to fine-tune control algorithms and enhance software performance.
cond_0166.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
8+ Years of hands-on experience in classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow.
Hands on experience in configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM).
Hands on experience in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge).
Expertise in manual C coding and debugging.
Hands on experience in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet).
Hands on experience in configuring NVM manager.
Proficient in programming languages such as C and C++ for embedded systems.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment and communicate clearly.
Excellent problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Preferred Requirements:
Good knowledge of Cryptographic algorithms like AES, RSA, etc.
Tools experience: EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, Lauterbach.
Knowledge of Microcontroller architecture (Infineon Aurix knowledge is an added advantage).
Experience of MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and the tailoring of the MCAL to meet project needs.
Familiarity with software development tools and debugging techniques.
Understanding of automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE).

Perform software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Actively participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Contribute to the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Support software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Work closely with system architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units.
Collaborate with calibration teams to fine-tune control algorithms and enhance software performance.
cond_0200.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 8 years of demonstrated expertise in classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow.
Deep knowledge of configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM).
Proven expertise in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge).
Strong command of manual C coding and debugging.
Advanced knowledge of Cryptographic algorithms such as AES, RSA, etc.
Proven expertise in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet).
Proven expertise in configuring NVM manager.
Strong command of programming languages C and C++ for embedded systems.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Strong leadership abilities and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment and communicate clearly.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in tools such as EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, and Lauterbach.
Solid understanding of Micro controller architecture; Infineon Aurix knowledge is an added advantage.
Substantial experience in MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and tailoring of the MCAL to meet project needs.
Proficiency in software development tools and debugging techniques.
Solid understanding of automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE).

cond_0233.responsibilities:
Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.
Execute software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Lead code reviews to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Drive the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Direct software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units in close coordination with system architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams.
Lead collaboration with calibration teams to fine-tune control algorithms and deliver improved software performance.
cond_0233.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
8+ Years of hands-on experience in classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow.
Hands on experience in configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM)
Hands on experience in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge)
Expertise in manual C coding and debugging
Good knowledge of Cryptographic algorithms like AES, RSA, etc.
Hands on experience in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet)
Hands on experience in configuring NVM manager.
Tools - EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, Lauterbach
Knowledge of Micro controller architecture (Infineon Aurix knowledge is added advantage)
Experience of MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and the tailoring of the MCAL to meet the project needs
Proficient in programming languages such as C and C++ for embedded systems.
Familiarity with software development tools and debugging techniques.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment and communicate clearly.
Excellent problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Understanding of automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE) is a plus.

cond_0263.intro: As an AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader Lead, you will contribute to the development of UDS Flash Bootloader solutions according to industry best practices for automotive applications. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, implement, and optimize software that complies with AUTOSAR standards and enhances vehicle performance and functionality.
cond_0263.responsibilities:
Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.
Perform software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Actively participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Contribute to the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Support software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Work closely with system architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units.
Collaborate with calibration teams to fine-tune control algorithms and enhance software performance.
cond_0263.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 8 years of demonstrated expertise in classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow.
Proven track record in configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM).
Extensive hands-on expertise in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge).
Deep expertise in manual C coding and debugging.
Advanced knowledge of Cryptographic algorithms like AES, RSA, etc.
Substantial hands-on expertise in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet).
Proven expertise in configuring NVM manager.
Strong command of tools including EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, and Lauterbach.
Advanced knowledge of Microcontroller architecture (Infineon Aurix knowledge is an added advantage).
Significant experience in MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and tailoring of the MCAL to meet project needs.
Deep proficiency in C and C++ programming for embedded systems.
Strong command of software development tools and debugging techniques.
Exceptional ability to collaborate in a team-oriented environment and communicate clearly.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Solid understanding of automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE) is a plus.

cond_0448.intro: We are looking for an AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader Lead to join our team. The role involves developing UDS Flash Bootloader solutions for automotive applications in line with industry best practices. You will coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to design, implement, and optimize software that meets AUTOSAR standards and supports vehicle performance and functionality.
cond_0448.responsibilities:
Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.
Perform software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Contribute to the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Support software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Coordinate with system architects, hardware engineers, and relevant cross-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units.
Coordinate with calibration teams on control algorithm tuning and software performance improvements.
cond_0448.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

Hands on experience in configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM)
Hands on experience in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge)
Expertise in manual C coding and debugging
Good knowledge of Cryptographic algorithms like AES, RSA, etc.
Hands on experience in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet)
Hands on experience in configuring NVM manager.
Tools - EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, Lauterbach
Knowledge of Micro controller architecture (Infineon Aurix knowledge is added advantage)
Experience of MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and the tailoring of the MCAL to meet the project needs
Proficient in programming languages such as C and C++ for embedded systems.
Familiarity with software development tools and debugging techniques.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting; able to work within a team-oriented environment.
Excellent problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Understanding of automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE) is a plus.

Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.

Actively participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.

Extensive hands-on expertise in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge).
Deep expertise in manual C coding and debugging.
Advanced knowledge of Cryptographic algorithms like AES, RSA, etc.
Substantial hands-on expertise in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet).
Proven expertise in configuring NVM manager.
Strong command of tools including EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, and Lauterbach.
Advanced knowledge of Microcontroller architecture (Infineon Aurix knowledge is an added advantage).
Significant experience in MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and tailoring of the MCAL to meet project needs.
Deep proficiency in C and C++ programming for embedded systems.
Strong command of software development tools and debugging techniques.
Exceptional ability to collaborate in a team-oriented environment and communicate clearly.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.

cond_0489.intro: As an AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader Lead, you will contribute to the development of UDS Flash Bootloader solutions according to industry best practices for automotive applications. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, implement, and optimize software that complies with AUTOSAR standards and enhances vehicle performance and functionality.
cond_0489.responsibilities:
Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.
Perform software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Actively participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Contribute to the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Support software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Work closely with system architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units.
Collaborate with calibration teams to fine-tune control algorithms and enhance software performance.
cond_0489.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 8 years of experience in classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM).
Background in Cybersecurity concepts (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto).
Experience with manual C coding and debugging.
Familiarity with Cryptographic algorithms such as AES, RSA, etc.
Experience configuring Diag and Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet).
Experience configuring NVM manager.
Familiarity with tools such as EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, and Lauterbach.
Experience with C and C++ programming for embedded systems.
Preferred Requirements
Exposure to Microcontroller architecture; familiarity with Infineon Aurix is a plus.
Experience with MCAL integration in AUTOSAR BSW and tailoring MCAL to meet project needs.
Comfort with software development tools and debugging techniques.
Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively in a team environment.
Willingness to develop problem-solving skills and attention to detail over time.
Some exposure to automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE) is a plus.

Develop, configure, and integrate AUTOSAR UDS Flash Bootloader according to industry best practices.
Work with the team on software validation, integration, and debugging on embedded systems, ensuring compliance with AUTOSAR specifications.
Write, maintain, and optimize high-quality code in accordance with coding standards and AUTOSAR guidelines.
Participate in code reviews together with peers to ensure code quality, reliability, and adherence to software development processes.
Coordinate with team members to investigate and resolve software-related issues, conducting thorough root cause analysis.
Contribute alongside colleagues to the creation of classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow and design documentation.
Support software testing activities, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation.
Work closely with system architects, hardware engineers, and cross-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications for automotive control units.
Coordinate with calibration teams to fine-tune control algorithms and enhance software performance.
cond_0612.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
8+ Years of hands-on experience in classic AUTOSAR architecture, UDS Flash Bootloader architecture and workflow.
Hands on experience in configuring AUTOSAR Diag stack and Memory Stack (FLS, FEE, NVM)
Hands on experience in Cybersecurity (Secure Flash, Secure Boot, HSM, Crypto knowledge)
Expertise in manual C coding and debugging
Good knowledge of Cryptographic algorithms like AES, RSA, etc.
Hands on experience in configuring Diag, Com Stack (CAN and Ethernet)
Hands on experience in configuring NVM manager.
Tools - EB Tresos, Isolar, CANoe, Lauterbach
Knowledge of Micro controller architecture (Infineon Aurix knowledge is added advantage)
Experience of MCAL integration in the AUTOSAR BSW and the tailoring of the MCAL to meet the project needs
Proficient in programming languages such as C and C++ for embedded systems.
Familiarity with software development tools and debugging techniques.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment and communicate clearly.
Excellent problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.
Understanding of automotive industry standards and regulations (ISO 26262, ASPICE) is a plus.
